note: On the Little Kentucky River Watershed Conservancy District's 136-acre flood-control lake, now run by a private operator. The loops fill a mowed point, with picnic tables along the lake between the outer road and the shore; some sites have sewer, the rest use the dump station. Boat rentals. Online booking up to 12 months ahead, 27 nights at a time. --Claude
summary: Kept (unmeasured long-stay share). Operator site lakejerichoky.com: 70 RV sites (stored 62), some with sewer, dump station, store. Operated by JO Investments LLC on the watershed district's lake; Google 4.2/209. Fees/booking left as AWH's 2026-10-16 ResNexus save. WATERFRONT DOWN lakefront -> lakeview: no camper pad identifiable on the lake side of the outer loop road; pads sit inside the loop 50-80 m from the shore and 8-9 m above it.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: lakefront -> lakeview. The stored evidence ('west and south loop camper pads within ~15-30m of the shoreline') does not hold on current imagery: Esri (winter, leaf-off) and NAIP show the outer loop road running 28-45 m from the shore with an open mowed lawn (picnic tables) between road and water and no pads on the lake side; the camper pads and trailers are inside the loop at ~50-80 m. 3DEP: lake 238.9 m; outer road 241.3-241.8 m (2.4-2.9 m up a gentle lawn) but interior pads 246.8-247.7 m (8-9 m above the water). Only the south road end (~38.4413,-85.2805, 1.2 m above the cove at ~24 m) reaches the edge, and nothing there reads as a numbered pad. The operator does claim 'waterfront sites', but no site is named and the ResNexus site list is unread (not opened by rule) - a lead to settle with the site map or a phone call, not grounds to keep the value. Not an --AWH value.

LONG-STAY / SEASONAL: imagery shows many trailers with decks and sheds inside the loops, and a guest review on the operator's home page praises the 'residents'. The nightly share is UNMEASURED (ResNexus not opened). AWH's 2026-10-16 save found nightly 'RV Site without Sewer'/'RV Site with Sewer' rates of $35-40, so nightly sites exist. Google 4.2 (209). A reviewer question if most sites are seasonal.

OWNERSHIP/OPERATOR: the lake and recreation area belong to the Little Kentucky River Watershed Conservancy District (Henry and Trimble counties); the campground is run by 'JO Investments LLC, dba Lake Jericho Recreation & RV Park' (policies page). 'local' kept; say so if AWH wants concession-run parks marked private.
